name: factory
description: Software factory skills: orchestrate takes Linear tickets through plan-ticket, implement-ticket, adversarial-review and merge-queue to a merged PR (or, for research-labelled tickets, through research-ticket to a report on the ticket), and decision-queue turns whatever stopped into decisions to answer. Each stage skill also runs on its own against one ticket. new-project stands up a new repo, Linear team and the factory wiring in one interactive sitting. /factory:preamble loads the operating manual.
